declarations.name: directions
declarations.description: The four direction names in sprite row order.

Attribute-driven rpg.actor sprites, expressions and talking with native HTML fallback.
See https://rpg.actor/dev-guide for the sprite grid and expression-sheet contract.
declarations.name: RpgActor

slots.description: Fallback HTML shown before loading and when base/selected sheets fail.

type.text: CustomEvent<{ animation: string, direction: string, expression: string, talking: boolean, paused: boolean }>

events.description: After observed attribute changes or showcase steps; not on initialization. Bubbles and composed; not cancelable.
events.name: actor-change

events.description: After a sheet loads. Bubbles and composed; not cancelable.
events.name: actor-load

events.description: Failed handle lookup, malformed emotes JSON, or image failure. Bubbles and composed; not cancelable.
events.name: actor-error

attributes.name: handle
attributes.description: Bluesky handle, optionally prefixed with @. Loads the public actor sprite and expressions. Missing or unavailable sprites use the bundled courier. An explicit src bypasses lookup.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Base sprite sheet URL, relative or HTTP(S). Omit to use the resolved or bundled sprite.

attributes.name: emotes
attributes.description: JSON map of expression names to emoteSheet and optional talkSheet image URLs.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Base grid columns, 1–16. Invalid values use 3; zero becomes 1.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Base grid rows, 1–16. Invalid values use 4; zero becomes 1.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction row, clamped to the sheet rows.

attributes.name: expression
attributes.description: Missing expression sheets fall back to src.

attributes.name: talking
attributes.description: Presence alternates open and closed mouth sheets.

attributes.name: paused
attributes.description: Presence freezes animation. Reflected by the built-in button.

attributes.name: showcase
attributes.description: Presence cycles available expressions and directions through idle, walking and talking poses.

attributes.name: showcase-duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds per pose, 150–60000, rounded up to the next frame. Invalid values use 2400; values below 150 become 150. Independent of interval.

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Frame duration in ms, 50–2000. Invalid values use 150; values below 50 become 50.

attributes.name: frame
attributes.description: Optional zero-based column override; invalid values use idle column.
